name: Joachim and Anna
Severian
troparia: (Tone 1) The just couple who lived in a state of grace,* Joachim and Anne, gave birth to this holy child for us.* The holy Church solemnly honours this feast in glory* and celebrates your precious memory today.* She glorifies God Who has lifted up our horn of salvation in the house of David.
kontakia: (Tone 3) Anna now rejoices, released from the bonds of barrenness,* and she nurtures the All-pure one,* inviting everyone to glorify in hymns* the One Who through hew womb made a gift to men:* the only one who was a Mother and did not know a man.
